advertiserId.description: ID of the advertiser account in the Transparency Center, for example AR16735076323512287233.

advertiserName.description: Ads: name of the advertiser account.

domain.description: Website of the ad or advertiser, when Google gives it.

creativeId.description: Ads: ID of the ad, for example CR08632639554903343105.

adUrl.description: Ads: link to the ad in the Transparency Center.

firstShown.description: Ads: when the ad was first shown (ISO date and time).

lastShown.description: Ads: when the ad was last shown (ISO date and time).

shownForDays.description: Ads: days between first and last shown.

isDynamic.description: Ads: true for dynamic search ads, whose headline Google writes from the landing page; their headline is empty.

headline.description: Ads: headline of a text ad, product title of a Shopping ad or name of an app ad; null when the ad is only a picture.

description.description: Ads: description line of the ad.

displayUrl.description: Ads: URL shown in the ad, for example nike.com.

businessName.description: Ads: business name shown in the ad, or the store of a Shopping ad.

adTexts.description: Ads: all texts of the ad, in order.

previewImageUrl.description: Ads: picture inside the ad, for example the product photo of a Shopping ad.

appName.description: Ads: name of the app, for app ads.

appId.description: Ads: ID of the app, for app ads.

destinationUrl.description: Ads: landing page or store link of the ad, when the preview has it.

callToAction.description: Ads: button text, for example Install or Visit Site.

imageUrl.description: Ads: picture of the whole ad as Google archived it.

width.description: Ads: width of the ad picture in pixels.

height.description: Ads: height of the ad picture in pixels.

previewUrl.description: Ads: link to Google's preview script of the ad.

variationCount.description: Ads, with Details: number of versions of the ad.

variations.description: Ads, with Details: every version of the ad, with its picture, size and texts.

regions.description: Ads, with Details: countries the ad ran in, each with first and last date and, in the EU, impressions per platform.

impressions.description: Ads, with Details: EU impressions as a range {min, max}; null outside the EU.

platformImpressions.description: Ads, with Details: EU impressions per platform (SEARCH, YOUTUBE, MAPS, PLAY, SHOPPING).

name.description: Advertisers: name of the advertiser account.

legalName.description: Advertisers: legal name of the advertiser, when Google gives it.

verified.description: Advertisers: true when Google verified the advertiser's identity.

adCountLow.description: Advertisers: lower bound of the advertiser's number of ads in the region, with the input's filters.

adCountHigh.description: Advertisers: upper bound of the advertiser's number of ads in the region, with the input's filters.

adsFound.description: Advertisers: number of the website's ads that come from this account (website searches).

advertiserUrl.description: Advertisers: link to the advertiser in the Transparency Center.

region.description: Region of the search: a country code such as US, or ANYWHERE.

source.description: Brand, website or advertiser from the input that found the record.
